Temporal Awareness Video Runbook

Goal: publish a strong technical video tonight without turning editing into a second research project.

The artifact

One talking-head educational video:

  • Length: 10-16 minutes.
  • Spine: you talking directly to camera.
  • Inserts: paper screenshots, terminal demos, simple diagrams.
  • Style: field note from someone building the system, not a polished documentary.

File workflow

Use the external SSD for raw media and keep the MacBook for project/proxy/export files.

External SSD/
  working-memory/
    2026-06-06-temporal-awareness/
      00_raw/
        camera/

Do not edit directly out of Downloads/Desktop. Put the 10GB ZV-E10 file in 00_raw/camera/ and leave it untouched.

Mac commands

Check the file:

ffprobe -hide_banner "/Volumes/YOUR_SSD/working-memory/2026-06-06-temporal-awareness/00_raw/camera/clip.mp4"

Create an edit-friendly proxy:

ffmpeg -i "/Volumes/YOUR_SSD/working-memory/2026-06-06-temporal-awareness/00_raw/camera/clip.mp4" \
  -vf "scale=1280:-2" -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 24 -c:a aac -b:a 160k \
  "/Volumes/YOUR_SSD/working-memory/2026-06-06-temporal-awareness/01_proxies/clip_proxy.mp4"

Extract audio for transcription:

ffmpeg -i "/Volumes/YOUR_SSD/working-memory/2026-06-06-temporal-awareness/00_raw/camera/clip.mp4" \
  -vn -ac 1 -ar 16000 -c:a pcm_s16le \
  "/Volumes/YOUR_SSD/working-memory/2026-06-06-temporal-awareness/00_raw/audio/voice.wav"

If you want quick OpenAI transcription:

python - <<'PY'
from openai import OpenAI
from pathlib import Path

audio = Path("/Volumes/YOUR_SSD/working-memory/2026-06-06-temporal-awareness/00_raw/audio/voice.wav")
out = audio.with_suffix(".transcript.txt")
client = OpenAI()
with audio.open("rb") as f:
    tr = client.audio.transcriptions.create(model="gpt-4o-transcribe", file=f)
out.write_text(tr.text)
print(out)
PY

If gpt-4o-transcribe is unavailable in the account, use Premiere's built-in transcription or Whisper locally.

Fastest edit path

Use Premiere or DaVinci Resolve, whichever opens the ZV-E10 footage more smoothly. If the Windows PC is slow, do not fight it tonight. Use the MacBook with proxies.

Cut in this order:

  1. Put the talking-head recording on the timeline.
  2. Remove dead air and obvious stumbles.
  3. Drop in the paper screenshots over the exact claims.
  4. Drop in terminal clips for the two demos.
  5. Add three simple title cards: "reasoning", "awareness", "memory".
  6. Normalize audio.
  7. Export 1080p H.264.

Do not animate everything. The audience needs clarity and conviction more than motion graphics.

Audio cleanup

In Premiere:

  • Essential Sound -> Dialogue.
  • Loudness auto-match.
  • Light noise reduction only; do not overprocess.
  • Add a limiter around -1 dB.

If using ffmpeg only:

ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -af "loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11" -c:v copy output_loudnorm.mp4

Publish package

Title options:

  • The Clock AI Agents Cannot Feel
  • Why AI Agents Are Time-Blind
  • Memory Is Not a Fact. It Is a State Transition.

Description skeleton:

LLM agents can reason about dates, but they do not maintain elapsed time as part of their own state. This video separates temporal reasoning, temporal awareness, and temporal memory, then shows why flat memory systems fail when facts change over time.

Sources:
- Temporal Blindness / TicToc: https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.23853
- Real-Time Deadlines: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.13206
- Robotouille: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.05227
- GEPA: https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.19457

Code/demos: link repo when cleaned enough.
